India to send Governor, Minister of State to Khamenei's funeral

India has decided to send Bihar Governor Syed Ata Hasnain and Minister of State for External Affairs Pabitra Margherita to represent the country at the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in Iran. The funeral is scheduled to take place next month. Commentators have suggested this event presents an opportunity for India to recalibrate its West Asia policy.
